result.summary: The page is largely intact and functional. Only minor polish issues were found: ambiguous promo wording for the '3 free deliveries' banner, an overlapping delivery badge on a food image, low-contrast small text in several places, and a notification bell with an empty red badge dot.

issues.description: The promo banner says "3 free deliveries for you" but the subtext says "min. order €10", which reads as if the offer is conditional rather than describing 3 free deliveries. The wording may confuse users about what they actually get.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the copy, e.g. "Get 3 free deliveries with code TALLINN3 (min. order €10)".

issues.description: The "€0 delivery" badge on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card overlaps the dish image and is positioned where it could obscure food details.
issues.suggestion: Keep badges in a consistent, less intrusive position, or place them outside the image on a solid background strip.

issues.description: Small text in promo and metadata lines (e.g. "€0.90 delivery", "Use code TALLINN3...", category chips) appears low-contrast against light gray/green backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast to meet WCAG AA (at least 4.5:1 for body-size text).

issues.description: The notification bell icon shows a red badge dot with no visible count, and the bell appears faint/greyed relative to the active page state, which can look like an unfinished or disabled element.
issues.suggestion: Make the bell clearly legible and give the badge an explicit count or remove the empty dot.
